description:
## VK Video 1.163 (51920) — lower-layer ad removal r3

Built after real-account testing showed that 1.163.2 still allowed an install-game ad in VK Clips and a skippable ad during long video playback.

New lower-layer blockers:
- Filter Clips SDK ads uses VK's own SDK ad-video predicate in the lower r11.d converter; ad-marked SDK videos return no FeedItem and are already skipped by existing callers.
- StaticAds and MarketAds intermediates are filtered before final Clips SDK feed items and install CTAs are built.
- Block deep midroll ads disables the dedicated request_midroll Runnable before it can pause the main video or enter InstreamAdEngine.
- Midpoint configuration and direct named midroll starts are also blocked as defense in depth.

The APK remains Android version 1.163 / 51920 and uses the same project signing certificate as 1.163.2, so it can be installed as an update over the previous project build.

Automated gates passed for Morphe application, ZIP/alignment, package/version, manifest coexistence, DEX application class, ARM64 native signature bypass, and final v3-only signature.
